target: AArch64 native ZealC in UTM-bundled QEMU with HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-source-context-escape-both-forms-58dd.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-source-context

checks.GrModels: Man and Ball DocForms accepted their defaults with plain Escape, both color choosers rendered, and both models generated and rendered inline. Man generated 112 vertices/168 triangles and had 1,200 nonblack pixels in the checked inline region; Ball generated 58 vertices and had 591 purple pixels. Both paths recovered to a terminal with zstatus failed=0.
checks.KeepAway: Court, HUD, and player rendered; Space/mouse input updated gameplay; terminal recovery and zstatus failed=0 passed.
checks.Titanium: Game frame, input, Escape recovery and terminal return passed.
checks.source_context: All eight source-context checks returned 0x2a and zstatus failed=0.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-keepaway-full-source-context-58dd.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-keepaway-full-game --probe-source-context

checks.KeepAway: Full 187-second run completed 18 repeated input cycles; scanout changed at every sample. Escape restored terminal focus, removed the Animate task, and zstatus reported failed=0.
checks.source_context: All eight source-context checks returned 0x2a and zstatus failed=0.

live_utm_status.GrModels: Automated render and input checks pass; visible UTM visual confirmation remains open after the earlier report that the model was not apparent.
live_utm_status.KeepAway: Automated full-game run did not reproduce the visible UTM freeze report; live UTM retest remains open.
live_utm_status.Titanium: User confirmed plain Left/Right, Space and Escape work in a live UTM session.

scope_note: These are automated runs using UTM-bundled QEMU, not visible UTM app-window or Pi hardware acceptance. The full-game soak does not explain the earlier visible-UTM KeepAway freeze report.
